newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Dec Hub natgas soars to new contract high.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Dec Hub natgas soars to new contract high.

text.p: NYMEX December Henry Hub natgas futures soared 9.8 cents to a new contract high Friday of $2.885 per million British thermal units on follow through technical buying after Thursday's rally.
At 1410 EST, December had extended its rally to reach a contract high of $2.895, replacing the previous high of $2.88.
Prior to Friday's session open, traders said the $2.83-2.85 area was a strong resistance level.
After breaking resistance, December rallied on technical buying, industry sources said.
